items.event_time_ist: ~10:00 AM IST, Oct 13 (detention); still held ~6:43 PM IST, Oct 13
items.summary: Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka and Ajinkya Shinde — re-detained at Jantar Mantar on Tuesday morning after climbing the gate — were taken to the Jaffarpur Kalan police station detention center in Dwarka district and were still in custody roughly seven hours later. CJP legal affairs head Ratna Singh demanded their release; Dipke's own handle posted that advocates were not being allowed inside; an independent journalist's reel shows the detained group photographed in front of the 'Police Station Jaffarpur Kalan Dwarka District' sign and sitting behind barricades. CJP alleged police seized the detainees' phones and initially denied them access to lawyers. Police have not responded.
items.title: Re-detained CJP leaders held ~7 hours at Jaffarpur Kalan PS; CJP alleges lawyers barred and phones seized
